postWhy.title: Why this post?
postWhy.lead: What brings it to your feed, based on the post itself.

reach.local: It is published for the {{country}} hub.
reach.diaspora: It is addressed to the whole diaspora, whatever the country.
reach.diasporaOrigin: It is addressed to the whole diaspora; it comes from the {{country}} hub.

audience.public: All DIASPORALE members can read it.
audience.connections: Its author keeps it for their connections, and you are one of them.
audience.group: It is posted in a group you belong to.
audience.page: It is posted on a page’s wall.

postWhy.root: Its author also made it readable in ANTSIA.
postWhy.order: The feed sorts posts by date, newest first. It takes neither your clicks nor your reading time into account.
postWhy.controls: From a post’s menu, you can hide it or mute its author; your choices are listed in your feed settings.
